reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR governs the construction and accepted physical delivery of non-building mining facilities: winding shafts and towers/headframes, mine tunnels, drifts and declines, and mine loading/discharging stations with their integral civil, support and permanent installation interfaces. An actual engineered open-pit access/initial mine-working facility is also in scope when its separately accepted physical extent and mining function are demonstrated. These are facilities associated with mining, not a construction service or a tonne of ore. Sources: `unsd-cpc-3-2025`; `wa-ground-control-2019`.

A dataset defines one complete facility or integrated mine-access/materials-handling delivery unit from actual design, as-built survey and acceptance records. Underground access, headframe and loading-station routes must not be replaced by a simpler unrelated structure. A contract section is a reference entity only if its complete functional interfaces and independently accepted extent are documented; do not choose an arbitrary metre of shaft, construction shift or minor component to bypass missing work.

Exclude buildings, public transport tunnels, independent power plants and manufacturing/chemical plants, independently delivered roads/pipelines, machinery/material manufacture sold separately, routine ore extraction/processing and mining services. Include genuinely integral mine-access and loading interfaces, with an asset/interface schedule preventing overlap. For rehabilitation, disclose retained assets, condition, removal and new work; do not charge their original manufacture again without an explicit attributed prior-asset boundary.

The principal boundary is actual construction-to-accepted-handover. Bought-material/equipment production, external transport, site construction, subsequent mine operation/maintenance/renewal, and closure/demolition/disposition are distinct stages. Upstream burden is linked only from verified compatible datasets; the foreground alone establishes neither complete cradle-to-gate nor whole life. Literature supplies route context, not universal recipes, dimensions, equipment necessity, quantities, lifespan, loads, emissions or compliance approval.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Accepted non-building mine shafts/headframes, mining tunnels/drifts/declines and loading/discharging facilities, or a documented integral combination; actual engineered initial open-pit facilities with established mining scope and handover.
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Exclude buildings, public transport tunnels, independent power plants and manufacturing/chemical plants, independently delivered roads/pipelines, machinery/material manufacture sold separately, routine ore extraction/processing and mining services. Include genuinely integral mine-access and loading interfaces, with an asset/interface schedule preventing overlap. For rehabilitation, disclose retained assets, condition, removal and new work; do not charge their original manufacture again without an explicit attributed prior-asset boundary.
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Complete accepted mining civil facility at the documented site and interfaces, with permanent equipment inclusions and remaining dependencies stated.

authored_review_metadata.identity_conditions: Every adopted identity is limited by the bilingual row condition and its actual public reference property/unit group. A blank UUID means not confirmed for this PCR, never proof of database non-existence.
evidence_limits: UN CPC provides category identity, not LCA approval. WA 2019 and IFC 2007 provide qualitative mine routes/environmental concerns, not current universal legal requirements or quantitative defaults.

Platreef February 2025 is a South African mine development case with forecasts; actual route observations are contextual only. No forecast completion, shaft size, capacity, mix, lifetime or project-specific intensity is generalized.
EPA 2012 supplies historical washout mechanism and stream separation only; its pH, recycling target and compliance statements are not numeric rules here.

Construction-to-handover foreground is not complete cradle-to-gate or whole life. Significant real unlisted route exchanges, geological gas, aqueous pollutants, land change, noise/vibration and occupational exposure need independent actual-project coverage review.
unresolved_evidence_needs: Actual independently accepted facility scope, geometry/configuration, complete construction route and handover test evidence.
Actual measured recipes, quantities, supplier states, fuel density/fossil fraction, water chemistry and species/size/receptor-specific releases.
Persistent reusable plant/formwork/support histories and evidenced total service denominators; unknown relations require review.
